title: ISSessions Espionage CTF
description:
The CTF will be held on January 27th to 28th, 2024, from 9:00AM to 5:00PM EST. The CTF will be held in person as well as hosted on the ISSessions Discord server https://discord.gg/WRdF8seaz7 .  Test your problem-solving and teamwork skills with a variety of challenges including web, forensics, crypto, and more. Perfect for hackers, developers, and digital enthusiasts ready for an espionage-themed adventure. The CTF is designed to be beginner-friendly while still offering more difficult challenges for advanced players. We will be giving out prizes to the top 3 teams. The prizes will be announced closer to the CTF date. We will also be giving out prizes for the best writeups. 

The CTF is only available to students currently attending a Canadian post-secondary institution. 

ISSessions is a student run cybersecurity club at Sheridan College. We couldn't do these events without the help of our sponsors! 
Trend Micro, Parabellyx Cybersecurity, more to come!
